description:
For a codebase: given the services it uses, list the free credits and programs each one's provider
        offers. Read package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Dockerfiles, Terraform and .env.example
        first and pass every external service you find.

eligible_as.description: Groups the person belongs to, if known. Programs open to anyone are always included.
eligible_as.title: Eligible As

per_service.description: Most programs to return per service.
per_service.title: Per Service

services.description: Services, companies or package names the project uses, read from its dependency and config files: "openai", "@supabase/supabase-js", "boto3", "Vercel", "posthog-js".
services.title: Services

name: credits_for_stack

last_checked.description: When the program was last checked against the provider's page (YYYY-MM-DD).
last_checked.title: Last Checked

needs_card.description: True when the provider asks for a credit card at signup; false means not listed.
needs_card.title: Needs Card

needs_phone.description: True when the provider asks for a phone number; false means not listed.
needs_phone.title: Needs Phone

offer.description: What you get, in the provider's terms.
offer.title: Offer

official_page.description: The provider's own page for the program. Show it to the person.
official_page.title: Official Page

worth_up_to_usd.description: The provider's "up to" dollar figure; null when it isn't a dollar amount.
worth_up_to_usd.title: Worth Up To Usd

no_programs_found.description: Services with no program in the catalog.
no_programs_found.title: No Programs Found

services.description: Services with at least one program, in the order passed.
services.title: Services

title: Find credits for a project's services
